jobs.description:
Leads Power, c’est quoi ?

Une agence dont le cœur de métier est la lead gen, avec un pôle e-commerce en plein développement. On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses.

Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées.

Ton rôle

Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.

Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.

Ce que tu fais au quotidien

  • Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

  • Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

  • Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

  • Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

  • Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

  • Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

  • Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

  • Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

  • Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège

  • Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair

  • Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus)

  • Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées

  • Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe

  • Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback

  • Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats

Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si

  • Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même

  • Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher

  • Tu n’as aucune réalisation concrète à montrer

Ce qu’on te propose

  • 100 % télétravail : tu bosses d’où ça te chante

  • Un vrai impact : tes concepts font scaler des comptes avec de gros budgets

  • Du terrain de jeu : plusieurs verticales, beaucoup de choses à tester

  • Une équipe derrière toi : performance managers, studio, automatisation

  • De l’autonomie pour proposer, tester et structurer le pôle créatif

  • Une évolution liée à tes résultats

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
jobs.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £90K – £110K • Offers Equity

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.
